messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered passages given.

Rules:
- Use only these passages. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the passages do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the passages.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several passages answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [passage numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: What is the last day on which a machine can be placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC so that Member States may not afterwards impede its making available on the market under the transitional provisions of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

Passages:
[0] REG, Art. 52(1): Article 52 Transitional provisions. 1. Member States shall not impede the making available on the market of products which were placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 14 January 2027. However, Chapter VI of this Regulation shall apply, from 13 July 2023, mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive, including products for which a procedure has already been initiated under Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC.

[1] eu-dir-2014-35, Art. 25: Article 25 Transitional provisions Member States shall not impede the making available on the market of electrical equipment covered by Directive 2006/95/EC which is in conformity with that Directive and which was placed on the market before 20 April 2016.

[2] eu-dir-2014-30, Art. 43: Article 43 Transitional provisions Member States shall not impede the making available on the market and/or the putting into service of equipment covered by Directive 2004/108/EC which is in conformity with that Directive and which was placed on the market before 20 April 2016.

[3] eu-reg-2023-988, Art. 51: Article 51 Transitional provision Member States shall not impede the making available on the market of products covered by Directive 2001/95/EC which are in conformity with that Directive and which were placed on the market before 13 December 2024.

[4] eu-dir-2014-35, Recital 36: (36) It is necessary to provide for reasonable transitional arrangements that allow the making available on the market, without the need to comply with further product requirements, of electrical equipment which has already been placed on the market in accordance with Directive 2006/95/EC before the date of application of national measures transposing this Directive. Distributors should therefore be able to supply electrical equipment that has been placed on the market, namely stock that is already in the distribution chain, before the date of application of national measures transposing this Directive.

[5] eu-reg-2023-988, Recital 105: (105) In order to allow economic operators and providers of online marketplaces sufficient time to adapt to the requirements of this Regulation, including information requirements, it is necessary to provide for a sufficient transitional period after the date of entry into force of this Regulation during which products covered by Directive 2001/95/EC which are in conformity with that Directive may still be placed on the market. Member States should therefore not impede the making available on the market of such products, including offers for sale.

[6] eu-dir-2014-68, Art. 48(2): Article 48 Transitional provisions. 2. Member States shall not impede the making available on the market and/or the putting into service of pressure equipment or assemblies covered by Directive 97/23/EC which are in conformity with that Directive and which were placed on the market before 1 June 2015.

[7] REG, Annex V, Part B, point 9: 9. Additional information: Signed for and on behalf of: … (place and date of issue): (name, function) (signature): ( 1 ) It is optional for the manufacturer to assign a number to the declaration of conformity. ( 2 ) It is optional to assign a number to the declaration of conformity. ( 3 ) Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 June 2023 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council and Council Directive 73/361/EEC ( OJ L 165, 29.6.2023, p. 1 ).

[8] eu-reg-2016-425, Art. 47(1): Article 47 Transitional provisions. 1. Without prejudice to paragraph 2, Member States shall not impede the making available on the market of products covered by Directive 89/686/EEC which are in conformity with that Directive and which were placed on the market before 21 April 2019.

[9] eu-dir-2014-34, Art. 41(1): Article 41 Transitional provisions. 1. Member States shall not impede the making available on the market or the putting into service of products covered by Directive 94/9/EC which are in conformity with that Directive and which were placed on the market before 20 April 2016.
